## LinkedIn post draft

Artificial intelligence becomes most useful when it improves clarity.

For a corporate portal, clarity means that a visitor can understand what is being shown, where the information comes from and how different parts of the public profile connect into a coherent business picture.

GNK ASG has published a new Insight on how AI can support public documents, financial information, market panels, technology modules and structured business communication within the GNK DINAMO Ltd. public content framework.

The focus is not automation for its own sake. The focus is controlled explanation: helping users move through public information faster, while keeping the source material visible and verifiable.

Read the full GNK ASG Insight:
